item: Founder of the Sesame endowment fund (fonds de dotation Sesame), Grenoble
detail: Founded and is associated with the Grenoble endowment fund Sesame, which links local businesses to solidarity associations. Listed in her official ministerial biography. A formal HATVP declaration of interests has been filed but is not yet published, so the official itemised list of interests is not publicly available.

item: Former lawyer at the Grenoble bar (2003-2017)
detail: Practised law (family and criminal law) at the Grenoble bar before entering full-time politics; withdrawn from the bar roll at her own request in 2017.
